data.name: Vishal Jagtap
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Vishal Jagtap has made a big mark in cricket. With 18 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 21, with an average of 11.67 and a quick strike rate of 107.36. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 2 sixes and 18 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 17.2 overs, taking 10 wickets at an economy rate of 9.35. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
